headline: Rescinded prior educational specifications for new high school and tabled motion for scaled-back option without classrooms or pool
summary: The board heard an update on state school construction reimbursement rates and budget estimates for the proposed new Wallingford High School. Members voted to rescind the 2025 educational specifications that included 17 classrooms and a natatorium, then tabled a motion to adopt Option 1 specifications without those features. The board also approved tuition rates for out-of-district students and a transfer of funds for storage containers.
decisions: Approved adding discussion and possible action to revisit the educational specifications for the proposed new high school, 7-1.
Approved rescinding the prior motion on educational specifications with 17 classrooms and the natatorium from 2025, 5-3.
Tabled the motion to accept Option 1 - educational specifications without 17 additional classrooms and the natatorium.
Accepted items 7.1-7.4 on the consent agenda, including meeting minutes and a gift of backpacks valued at $710.00.
Approved the 2026-2027 tuition rates for out of district students as outlined in the memo from Mr. Barone.
Approved transferring $17,500 from the 2% Fund for storage containers at Lyman Hall and Sheehan.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion Passed - Approval to add Discussion and Possible Action to the Agenda to Revisit the Educational Specifications for the Proposed One New Wallingford High School Since we are getting an Update on Budgeting and Reimbursement Rates.
Motion Passed - Approval to Rescind the Motion already made on the Educational Specifications with 17 Classrooms and the Natatorium from 2025.
Motion Passed - Unanimous Approval to Table the Motion to Accept Option 1 - Educational Specifications without 17 Classrooms and the Natatorium.
Motion Passed - Unanimous Approval to Accept Items 7.1 - 7.4 on the Consent Agenda.
Motion Passed - Unanimous approval of the 2026 - 2027 Tuition Rates for Out of District Students as outlined in the Memo from Mr. Barone.
Motion Passed - Unanimous approval of the Transfer of $17,500 from the 2% Fund for the Storage Containers at Lyman Hall and Sheehan.
